what_is_read.truncation_sufficiency: For k in {1,2}: rank of KO_TOPk among its 40 norm-matched random rank-k controls on stat = mean_d(arm - KO); p_k = (1 + #controls >= TOPk)/41; Holm over k in {1,2}. retention_k = stat(TOPk)/stat(REEXP) with domain-bootstrap 95% CI.
what_is_read.minimal_sufficient_learned_subspace: k* = smallest k with Holm p < 0.05 AND retention CI lower bound >= 0.5. If none: 'no k <= 2 retains the CAND effect specifically' (the rank-4 operator's effect is not carried by its top-1/top-2 learned components, or not specifically).
what_is_read.removal_necessity: loss_i = stat(REEXP) - stat(DROP_i) with domain-bootstrap CI and frac_i = loss_i / stat(REEXP), i = 1..4. Descriptive only (no matched control family for removal).
what_is_read.power_floor: 40 controls -> p floor 1/41 = 0.0244; Holm over 2 -> 0.0488 < 0.05: a k qualifies only if TOPk is strictly first among its controls at one k (and p <= 0.05 at the other) -- attainable but at the floor.
